post.description: Extracts public profile data. The submitted URL determines whether the successful response is a person or company object.
post.x-airscale-credit-cost: URL-selected: /in/ successes cost 1 credit by default (workspace-specific pricing may differ); /company/ or /school/ successes cost 0.5 credits; unsuccessful requests are not charged.

requestBody.description: The LinkedIn URL is trimmed and a missing scheme is normalized. The hostname must be linkedin.com or a subdomain, and the first path segment must be /in/, /company/, or /school/. Query and extra path segments are canonicalized away. The submitted URL type chooses the person or company response and successful credit cost, regardless of which of these two routes receives it. When mode is omitted, the response can use a variable source shape; modes p2 and p3 request normalized shapes.

200.description: The submitted URL selects a person or company profile response.

post.summary: Find a profile from an email
post.description: Resolves a public person profile from an email address, or returns the JSON string "not found" when no profile is available.
post.x-airscale-credit-cost: 2 credits only when a profile is returned; "not found" and errors are not charged.

requestBody.description: The email is trimmed and lowercased before lookup. It must have a non-empty local part, an @ sign, and a domain containing a dot.

post.summary: Find a profile from a phone number
post.description: Resolves a public person profile from a phone-number string, or returns a not_found status when no profile is available.
post.x-airscale-credit-cost: 10 credits only when a profile is returned; not_found and errors are not charged.

requestBody.description: The mobile_phone value is trimmed before lookup and must contain at least one non-whitespace character. The exact trimmed lowercase strings "null" and "undefined" are treated as missing input.

post.description: Searches for people who match structured person, role, and company filters. The JSON request body is limited to 256 KiB.
post.x-airscale-credit-cost: 0.1 credits per returned lead; no charge when no leads are returned.

requestBody.description: Provide at least one supported query filter. Search pagination accepts a page size from 1 to 100 and an optional opaque cursor.

jobTitle.description: Matches the person's current role or job title.

school.description: Matches a school name on the person's profile.

languages.description: Matches a language name or code on the person's profile.

skills.description: Matches a skill name on the person's profile.

location.description: Matches the person or current-role location. Country names and ISO alpha-2 codes are accepted.

keyword.description: Matches text on the person's profile.

currentCompanyName.description: Matches the person's current company name.

companyDomain.description: Matches a current company domain; URL input is normalized to its hostname. Values merge with companyLinkedinUrl into one current-company identifier filter.

companyLinkedinUrl.description: Matches a current company profile URL or identifier. Values merge with companyDomain into one current-company identifier filter.

currentCompany.location.description: Matches the current company headquarters location.

currentCompany.keyword.description: Matches text on the current company profile.

pastJobTitle.description: Matches a title in a previous position.

pastCompanyWebsite.description: Matches a previous company website or domain.

pastCompany.location.description: Matches a previous company headquarters location.

pastCompany.keyword.description: Matches text on a previous company profile.

totalYearsOfExperience.description: Matches the person's total years of experience.

timeInCurrentCompany.description: Matches years spent at the current company.

currentCompany.headcountGrowth.description: Matches current company headcount growth for a supported timespan.

pastCompany.headcountGrowth.description: Matches previous company headcount growth for a supported timespan.

cursor.description: An opaque value returned as next_cursor by the preceding page. Send it unchanged.

200.description: A page of matching public lead records.

post.description: Searches for companies using firmographic, geographic, event, intent, technology, and website filters. The JSON request body is limited to 256 KiB.
post.x-airscale-credit-cost: 0.1 credits per returned company; no charge when no companies are returned.

requestBody.description: Provide at least one real company filter. Defaults such as eventWindow and locationMatch do not count as filters.

country.description: Matches a recognized country name or ISO alpha-2 code.

region.description: Matches a canonical region code, Region|Country value, or a region name scoped by country. Discover canonical values with GET /v1/find-companies/filter-values.

city.description: Matches a resolvable city value. Discover accepted values with GET /v1/find-companies/filter-values.

industry.description: Matches a canonical company industry. Discover accepted values with GET /v1/find-companies/filter-values.

revenue.description: Matches a fixed company revenue range.

age.description: Matches a fixed company age range.

techStack.description: Matches a technology used by the company. Discover accepted values with GET /v1/find-companies/filter-values.

keywords.description: Matches text found on the company website.

topics.description: Matches a canonical business-intent topic. Discover accepted values with GET /v1/find-companies/filter-values.

events.description: Matches a fixed recent company event.

locations.description: Matches a fixed range for the number of company locations.

eventWindow.description: Sets the recent-event window. Null or blank values use the default 30 days.

locationMatch.description: Controls whether location filters match headquarters only or headquarters and operating locations. Null or blank values use the default hqOnly.

hasWebsite.description: Matches companies by whether a website is present; null leaves this criterion unset.

isPublicCompany.description: Matches companies by public-company status; null leaves this criterion unset.

page.description: A zero-based page supplied as an integer JSON number or one of the equivalent canonical decimal strings. OpenAPI intentionally uses canonical decimal strings even though runtime Number() accepts additional spellings.

size.description: A page size from 1 through 100 supplied as an integer JSON number or one of the equivalent canonical decimal strings. OpenAPI intentionally uses canonical decimal strings even though runtime Number() accepts additional spellings.

cursor.description: An opaque fc_ cursor returned by the preceding page. When supplied, its saved page size takes precedence over new page or size values.

200.description: A page of matching sanitized public company records.

get.description: Discovers normalized values accepted by location, industry, intent-topic, and technology filters.
get.x-airscale-credit-cost: No charge; Filter-values does not debit Airscale credits.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: The Find Companies filter whose accepted values should be discovered.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: At least one of q or query is required and must contain 2 to 120 characters after trimming. When q is present it is read first; a blank q suppresses query and returns 400.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: At least one of q or query is required and must contain 2 to 120 characters after trimming. query is used only when q is absent.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Omitted, non-numeric, or non-integer values default to 20; an explicit empty value becomes 0 then clamps to 1; integers below 1 clamp to 1; integers above 100 clamp to 100.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Optional country context supplied as repeat or comma-separated values.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Optional region context supplied as repeat or comma-separated values; a bare region name needs country context.

200.description: Normalized filter values matching the query and optional location context.

post.description: Researches a public question and returns a sourced answer with optional requested output fields. The JSON request body is limited to 256 KiB.
post.x-airscale-credit-cost: 1 credit only for status success; not_found and timeout are not charged.

requestBody.description: Provide a non-empty prompt and, optionally, a map of requested output names to type keywords or descriptions.

prompt.description: A research question or instruction that remains non-empty after surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

schema.description: Maps arbitrary requested output names to non-empty type keywords or plain-language descriptions. Stable envelope names are reserved because dynamic requested fields must not collide with status, response, reasoning, sources, confidence_score, certainty_tag, or duration_ms.

value.prompt: What category does Airscale use to describe its service at https://airscale.io?

200.description: A completed research result, including successful, not-found, and soft-timeout outcomes.

items.description: A public source URL or source label such as serp_snippets.

value.response: Airscale is a sales data enrichment platform.
value.reasoning: The web page and public search snippets agree.

IncludeExcludeFilter.description: Use include, exclude, or both. Empty arrays and empty string values are accepted by the runtime, but meaningful non-empty values are recommended.

GrowthFilter.description: Headcount growth bounds for one supported timespan. When both bounds are present, min must be less than or equal to max.
GrowthFilter.x-airscale-runtime-constraint: When both are present, min must be less than or equal to max.
